title: Async Rule-version failure callbacks silently lose notification
description: Node.set_on_rule_version_failure accepts coroutine/async callables and _record_schc_failure invokes them synchronously without rejecting or awaiting the result. The tracker marks the threshold notified, the coroutine never runs, and the exact-once operator alert is lost. Require an exact synchronous callback and reject/cancel/close unexpected awaitables without consuming notification state, with regression tests.
notes: Security review also confirmed a raising callback is invoked only after the tracker sets notified=True; the exception propagates and later failures never retry until an unrelated successful decompression resets the signer. Acceptance must cover raise-once/retry and callback reentry, not only coroutine rejection.
